_note: Archer path, non-caster classes only (Marksman + Hunter) — DRAFT for Game Owner review. Arcane Ranger is a minor caster covered by the spell files. Schema mirrors abilities-warrior.json (Conqueror pilot). Neither class has a class resource (resourceType null) — abilities cost AP only, costs: []. Sources: C&S PDF pp.53-54 (Marksman) and pp.59-62 (Hunter). Skipped pure always-on passives: Marksman Perfect Aiming (doubled archery-training bonus on body-part shots, p.53), Bow Mastery (+2 to hit with all bows/crossbows, L8), Sky Shots (L20: every attack self-grants high ground); Hunter Telepathic Communication (L2: telepathy with companion within 60 ft), Trap Upgrades (L4: traps last 10 min + allies unaffected; 'Trap upgrade (2)' L10: max 5 traps / 1 hour; L16 'Trap upgrade (3)': max 10 traps / 24 hours). Positional damage bonuses (Ballistic Shots, High Ground, Flanking Buddy) are modeled as 0-AP attack-enhancer toggles because the server cannot know positioning — the player declares the condition. Trap common rules (p.60): save DC = 8 + 2 x proficiency; a trap occupies one 5-ft square; triggers when any creature walks into it; base limit 3 placed traps lasting up to 1 minute (see upgrades above); placing a 4th deactivates the oldest; cannot stack traps or place under creatures; optional stealth check vs onlookers' perception to hide placement; placing a trap in combat costs 1 AP. Open questions AR1-AR8 listed with the orchestrator report.

abilities.name: Ballistic Shots
abilities.description: You deal more damage the closer you are to your target. At 50 ft or less: double the modifier and dice damage of the shot (also applies on high ground). At 15 ft or less: double ALL the damage of the attack (also applies on high ground AND power shot). The damage increase does not apply to any other damage increase effects. Declared per attack — the player confirms the range band.

abilities.name: High Ground
abilities.description: You deal bonus damage per attack when you have high ground relative to your foe: 2d10 (level 2), 4d10 (level 10), 6d10 (level 16). Declared per attack — the player confirms the positioning.

abilities.name: Combat Tactic: Giant Slayer
abilities.description: When attacking a foe larger than you, you deal 1d10 additional damage for each size category between yours and the creature's (1d10 bonus vs large, and so on).

abilities.name: Combat Tactic: Flurry of Arrows
abilities.description: When attacking a foe, you can also attempt to attack all other enemies within 5 ft of it for free (does not stack with itself).

abilities.name: Combat Tactic: Crippling Shots
abilities.description: When attacking a foe, you reduce its speed by 10.

abilities.name: Power Shot
abilities.description: When attacking, you can choose to take -5 to the attack roll for +10 damage (+20 from level 13). If the power-shot attack roll goes below the target's AC, the attack misses altogether.

abilities.name: Tactical Retreat
abilities._question: AR1 — 'Resets when you crit on a ranged weapon attack' implies limited uses: how many base uses, and per what window (combat? rest?)
abilities.description: You jump to a point within 60 ft of you that you can see. Costs 1 AP. Resets when you crit on a ranged weapon attack.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities._question: AR2 — full rules text falls outside the extracted pages (likely p.55); summary used. Confirm exact wording, AP cost, and how 'once per long rest' maps to the single quality-tiered rest
abilities.description: Double your range this turn; Ballistic Shots can add its base damage again at 200 ft or more. Once per rest.

abilities.name: Animal Companion
abilities._question: AR3 — companion stats, abilities, HP flee thresholds, and AP recovery come from the 'hunter animals table', which is not in this section of the document. Where does it live?
abilities.description: You train one loyal animal companion. You act on the same turn and share your AP pool: during your turn you may spend AP freely between yourself and your companion, in any order. The companion's own AP recovery (if any) is added to yours but can only be spent on the companion's actions and movement. Each animal type has its own stats and abilities (hunter animals table). Each companion has an HP threshold at which it automatically disengages and flees, rejoining you after licking its wounds.

abilities.name: Explosive Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square; see trap rules in _note). On trigger it explodes: ALL creatures within 15 ft make a DEX save (DC 8 + 2 x proficiency), taking [4d6 + (your level) x 2d6] fire damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

abilities.name: Bear Trap
abilities._question: AR6 — trap conditions (rooted/blinded/frozen/stunned) read as binary save-ends conditions; how do they map onto the stack-threshold negative effect system?
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). If triggered by a creature of size large or smaller, the target is rooted; it can roll a STR save (DC 8 + 2 x proficiency) at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

abilities.name: Blinding Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). When triggered it explodes, blinding all creatures within 10 ft for 3 rounds; creatures can roll a CON save (DC 8 + 2 x proficiency) at the end of each of their turns to end the effect early.

abilities.name: Flanking Buddy
abilities.description: You deal bonus damage to a target that is within 5 ft of your animal companion and has been damaged by it since last round: 1d12 (level 2), 2d12 (level 10), 3d12 (level 16). Declared per attack — the player confirms the flanking condition.

abilities.name: Bait Trap
abilities._question: AR3 — DC uses animal proficiency and animal STR mod from the missing hunter animals table
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). When triggered, your animal companion rushes the triggering creature (taking no damage during the rush) and attacks it with a great attack: advantage, and the dice damage is dealt twice. The target must make a CON save vs DC [8 + animal proficiency + animal STR mod] or be knocked prone. The target cannot be more than 1 size larger than your companion for this effect to proc.

abilities.name: Blink Trap
abilities._question: AR7 — 1 AP per placement (2 total): must both points be placed with the same action, and does the pair count as 2 traps against your maximum?
abilities.description: Place 2 linked traps, one start point and one end point (1 AP each, 2 AP total). Only the start point triggers. On trigger, the target is teleported to the other point. The two traps cannot be more than 200 ft apart.

abilities.name: Freeze Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). The triggering target becomes frozen and must roll a CON save (DC 8 + 2 x proficiency). On a success the freeze ends at the end of their current turn; on a fail it instead ends at the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Linked Souls
abilities._question: AR5 — DC is written '[8 + killer's might/level]': might divided by level, or 'might or level'?
abilities.description: While both you and your companion are alive: when either of you would take lethal damage, the one who took the damage can make a CON save against DC [8 + killer's might/level] to remain at 1 HP instead.

abilities.name: Death Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). The target that triggers it takes 5d10 additional damage from all physical attacks made by both you and your companion for 3 rounds.

abilities.name: Astral Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). The triggering target must succeed on an INT save (DC 8 + 2 x proficiency) or be transported to the astral plane alongside a spirit clone of your animal companion (exact same stats, at your companion's current HP); your real companion remains in the mortal plane. The target stays there until either it or the spirit dies. If the spirit dies, the target returns and the damage the spirit took is transferred to it. If the target dies, its lifeless body returns to the mortal plane.

abilities.name: Mass Stun Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap (1 AP, one 5-ft square). On trigger, all targets within 20 ft must make a CON save (DC 8 + 2 x proficiency) or be stunned for 1 round.

abilities.name: Spirit Animal
abilities._question: AR8 — AP/time cost of the whistle summon/unsummon is unspecified; upgraded stats/abilities come from the missing hunter animals table (AR3)
abilities.description: Via a ritual, your companion becomes your spirit animal, staying with you forever (or until you die). Its stats are increased and abilities are added. It can now stay in the astral plane, and you can summon or unsummon it with a whistle. If it dies, it returns to the astral plane and is reconstructed in 24 hours.
